summary: Legacy recent recovery depends on a matching catalog entry and same-generation revision; recents referencing removed/replaced catalog entries are silently dropped, and no test covers successful hydration.
claim: Legacy catalog recents may disappear after catalog replacement/removal, contradicting recovery intent; testing gap leaves hydration unverified.

evidence.source: restoreLegacyRecent returns null if byId(id) returns null or revision mismatch; StorageAcceptanceTest only tests decodeSnapshot rejection and DB preservation, not actual hydration output.

suggested_remediation: Either preserve legacy recents as self-contained snapshots (including original values) or document/accept loss; add test that hydrates a legacy recent with matching catalog entry and verifies full item.
suggested_validation: Create legacy DB with recent for known package, run init, assert recent appears with all fields and provenance.
